screens.name: Leaderboard - How the ranking is calculated (formula spec)
features: Collapsible panel 'How the ranking is calculated' with '1,000 points available'
'See the numbers behind the score - Each ratio is multiplied by its maximum points and rounded. The four rounded scores are then added.'; 'Worked example' dropdown 'BITS Pilani (Selected)'
Table Measure / Formula and what counts / BITS Pilani: calculation / Points
Coverage max 400: Accepted datasets / total datasets x max; 'Only datasets whose latest receipt is accepted count in the numerator.'
Data quality max 250: Accepted rows / (accepted + rejected rows) x max; 'Rows without a validation result do not count.'; '2,108 accepted + 159 rejected = 2,267 validated rows.'

Timeliness max 200: Early datasets / received datasets x max; 'Early means the receipt date is at least 30 calendar days before the configured due date. All received datasets count in the denominator, including those without a due date; those without a due date earn no early credit.'
Automation max 150: Datasets received via API / received datasets x max; 'API receipts count whether accepted, processing or needing correction. Other receipt channels count only in the denominator.'
Total banner: '78 + 232 + 67 + 150 = 527 / 1,000 points', 'Current rank #33 of 37'

Footnotes: banker's rounding ('an exact .5 rounds to the nearest even number (12.5 becomes 12; 13.5 becomes 14)'), 'A zero denominator earns 0 points', 'Standings use Fall - 2026-2027, with one receipt per dataset. Changing the Home reporting period does not change these standings.', 'Equal scores have separate rank positions. Ties are ordered by institution code.', 'Early submission ... is not the percentage of missed deadlines.'
strengths: Fully transparent, worked-example methodology with a selector to re-run for any institution
Edge cases (rounding, zero denominator, ties) documented
gaps: Documented model confirms the flaws: lateness not penalised, no-due-date datasets in the timeliness denominator, DQ/timeliness/automation normalised by submitted rather than required, one receipt per dataset (no resubmission), tie-break by code
Weights are hard-coded; no versioning of the methodology or effective-date
Standings pinned to Fall 2026-2027 regardless of period picker
